response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS difference FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
